hyperedges.label: Request path: Cloudflare -> nginx -> backend -> PostGIS

nodes.label: Reviewer moderation workflow
nodes.rationale: Only approved markings appear publicly; submissions start pending so reviewers can moderate before exposure.

nodes.label: Licensing: AGPL-3.0 code / ODbL 1.0 data
nodes.rationale: Code is copyleft AGPL; community map data under ODbL to keep it open.

nodes.label: robots.txt crawl policy
nodes.rationale: Disallows /mine, /review and /api/ so private and moderation pages are not indexed.

nodes.label: App shell template (nav, theme toggle, footer)
nodes.norm_label: app shell template (nav, theme toggle, footer)

nodes.label: SMTP env vars (optional, LSA-B4)
nodes.rationale: Marked optional so the pod still starts before SMTP credentials are added to app-secrets; backend logs an error and sends no email until then.

nodes.label: frontend-nginx-config ConfigMap
nodes.rationale: Production nginx config overrides frontend/nginx.conf baked into the image; must be kept in sync.

nodes.label: nginx Security Headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options)
nodes.rationale: Headers live in location / rather than server level so proxied /api/ responses keep only the backend's helmet headers (LSA-B9).

nodes.label: /.well-known/ location (security.txt)
nodes.rationale: Serve as-is; never fall back to the SPA.

nodes.label: geo-seed CronJob (weekly, npm run seed:geo)
nodes.rationale: 2-hour activeDeadline to cover 197 cities plus retries.

nodes.label: Community Voting & Auto-approval
nodes.rationale: Threshold (default 10 net upvotes) lets community vetting reduce reviewer load; open questions about vote manipulation and sock puppets.

nodes.label: Reopened Items Policy
nodes.rationale: Items previously ticked but found broken in production stay open until verified on coloursofsafety.com, not just merged.

nodes.label: LSA-B1 Public API leaks user fields
nodes.rationale: Account-takeover primitive: pending email and live email-change tokens readable by anyone once a real user's submission is approved.
nodes.norm_label: lsa-b1 public api leaks user fields

nodes.label: LSA-B2 isAnonymous not enforced
nodes.rationale: On an LGBTQIA+ safety map exposing authors of anonymous submissions can out people.

nodes.label: LSA-B4 Emails never sent; tokens logged
nodes.norm_label: lsa-b4 emails never sent; tokens logged

nodes.label: LSA-B8 Token in localStorage without CSP
nodes.rationale: Any XSS can exfiltrate the session; fix via HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict cookie or at minimum strict CSP.
nodes.norm_label: lsa-b8 token in localstorage without csp

nodes.label: LSA-B12 Seeded Wikidata data quality
nodes.rationale: Seeder-assigned ratings presented with community authority is a trust problem on a safety map.

nodes.label: LSA-B14 Tracking before consent (GTM, Sentry)
nodes.rationale: For an at-risk audience, loading GTM before consent already transmits visitor IP to Google.

nodes.label: LSA-A1 Map places unreachable by keyboard
nodes.norm_label: lsa-a1 map places unreachable by keyboard

nodes.label: LSA-F6 Marker clustering inactive in prod
nodes.norm_label: lsa-f6 marker clustering inactive in prod

nodes.label: Recommended Fix Priority
nodes.rationale: Security/privacy first (B1,B2,B4,B5,B8/B9), then broken core features, trust, accessibility, polish.

nodes.label: Safety Rating Colours (red to green)
nodes.rationale: Red-green scale problematic for deuteranopia/protanopia; each rating needs a secondary icon/pattern indicator.

nodes.label: Admin Panel (/admin, adminGuard)
nodes.rationale: Self-demotion prevention and super_admin protection guard against privilege escalation.

nodes.label: Angular SSR
nodes.rationale: CSR-only Angular apps have poor SEO; SSR or prerendering lets crawlers index dynamic content.

nodes.label: Angular SSR
nodes.rationale: Critical for SEO / search visibility; listed in TODO Phase 2

nodes.label: Database Migrations
nodes.rationale: Replace TypeORM synchronize:true for production safety

nodes.label: Cluster Markers
nodes.rationale: Group nearby POIs at low zoom for performance and UX; Leaflet.markercluster quick win

nodes.label: Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: Prevent abuse; high priority, low effort

nodes.label: Email Verification
nodes.rationale: Verify before allowing submissions to prevent spam

nodes.label: Anonymous Submissions
nodes.rationale: Privacy for vulnerable users

nodes.label: Engagement Funnel
nodes.rationale: Browse -> Register -> Contribute -> Return; awareness, activation, contribution, retention, advocacy

nodes.label: Social Proof Counter
nodes.rationale: Anchoring and bandwagon effect; derived from existing GET /api/pois and /api/districts lengths

nodes.label: Soft Gate Drawing
nodes.rationale: Zeigarnik effect: let guests start drawing, gate at submit; draw:created handler checks isLoggedIn()

nodes.label: Onboarding Tooltip Tour
nodes.rationale: Guided mastery; single-use localStorage flag cos.onboarded

nodes.label: Status Notification
nodes.rationale: Variable reward schedule; closes feedback loop; opt-in only

nodes.label: Contributor Tiers
nodes.rationale: Bronze/Silver/Gold badges; contributionCount on AuthUser computed at login

nodes.label: Reviewer Nomination
nodes.rationale: Autonomy + purpose after 10 approved submissions

nodes.label: Share A Place
nodes.rationale: Social currency; OG-rich link

nodes.label: Invite Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Network effect with referral tracking

nodes.label: Dark Patterns Anti-Pattern
nodes.rationale: Never guilt-trip or create false urgency: this is a safety tool for a vulnerable community

nodes.label: Over-Gamification Anti-Pattern
nodes.rationale: Badges warm not competitive; no leaderboards

nodes.label: Never Gate Core Value
nodes.rationale: Map must remain fully browsable without an account; never hide safety information

nodes.label: North Star Metric: Weekly Active Contributors
nodes.rationale: Primary metric: users who submit or review
nodes.norm_label: north star metric: weekly active contributors

nodes.label: SEO Organic Search
nodes.rationale: High impact long-term; long-tail city queries

nodes.label: Community Partnerships
nodes.rationale: High impact, low cost

nodes.label: Reddit Outreach
nodes.rationale: Value-first, never spam

nodes.label: Influencer Seeding
nodes.rationale: Trust transfer

nodes.label: Shareable Place Links
nodes.rationale: Each place gets /place/[id] with auto-generated OG image

nodes.label: Referral Flow
nodes.rationale: ?ref=[username]; both get badge when referred user submits

nodes.label: Contributor Badges
nodes.rationale: Pioneer, Guardian, Explorer

nodes.label: Viral Coefficient
nodes.rationale: Target K > 0.3

nodes.label: Risk Mitigation
nodes.rationale: Never gate safety info; transparent moderation

nodes.label: C1 Map No Accessible Alternative
nodes.rationale: WCAG 1.1.1; add role=application and aria-label

nodes.label: C5 Colour Only Safety Indicator
nodes.rationale: WCAG 1.4.1 Use of Color

nodes.label: C6 Toast Live Region Missing
nodes.rationale: WCAG 4.1.3; role=status aria-live=polite; top priority (1 line)

nodes.label: C9 Outline None No Replacement
nodes.rationale: WCAG 2.4.7; add outline for forced-colors

nodes.label: M1 Skip Navigation Link Absent
nodes.rationale: WCAG 2.4.1

nodes.label: M4 Nav Link Contrast
nodes.rationale: WCAG 1.4.3; #c7c9d9 on #1d1f2b

nodes.label: Reduced Motion
nodes.rationale: prefers-reduced-motion not considered for toast

nodes.label: Missing LGBTQIA+ Categories
nodes.rationale: Bookstore, youth center, support group, HIV/STI testing, trans services, crisis shelter, legal aid, religious, sexual health clinic

nodes.label: Red-Green Color Scale Issue
nodes.rationale: #d7263d -> #2e933c problematic for deuteranopia/protanopia (~8% of males); add patterns/icons

nodes.label: Pronouns Field
nodes.rationale: Always optional, never public without consent

nodes.label: Anonymity Mode
nodes.rationale: displayName shown publicly is dangerous for non-out users or those in unsafe regions

nodes.label: Multi-Dimensional Safety Model
nodes.rationale: A 5 in one dimension does not guarantee a 5 in another; gay bar may be hostile to trans women

nodes.label: Content Moderation Bias Risk
nodes.rationale: Reviewer unconscious bias; no appeals process; recommends reviewerGuidelines.md

nodes.label: GDPR Article 9
nodes.rationale: Sexual orientation data inferred from usage needs explicit consent

nodes.label: OpenStreetMap Overpass API
nodes.rationale: Primary source; ODbL; excellent Western Europe coverage

nodes.label: OSM lgbtq Tag
nodes.rationale: lgbtq=primary->5, welcome->4, yes->3, limited->2

nodes.label: Wikidata SPARQL
nodes.rationale: CC0; named LGBTQ+ organisations

nodes.label: ILGA-Europe Rainbow Map
nodes.rationale: Country-level legal baseline; non-commercial only; score % mapped to safetyRating 1-5

nodes.label: Foursquare Places API
nodes.rationale: Fill OSM gaps only

nodes.label: Yelp Fusion API
nodes.rationale: Fill OSM gaps only

nodes.label: GADM
nodes.rationale: Academic/non-commercial polygons

nodes.label: Natural Earth
nodes.rationale: Public domain

nodes.label: Seed Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Seed data inserted as approved to bypass reviewer queue

nodes.label: Safety Scale 1-5
nodes.rationale: 5 Safe, 4 Mostly Safe, 3 Neutral, 2 Caution, 1 Danger

nodes.label: COC Nederland
nodes.rationale: World's oldest LGBTQ+ org (1946)

nodes.label: Urban vs Rural Divide
nodes.rationale: Strongest predictor of safety; capitals score 1-2 points higher than national average

nodes.label: Tourism Area Effect
nodes.rationale: Mykonos, Sitges, Maspalomas, Hvar score 5 regardless of national context

nodes.label: Central-Eastern Europe Bifurcation
nodes.rationale: Czechia, Estonia, Slovenia improving; Poland, Hungary, Slovakia regressing

nodes.label: Annual Refresh Requirement
nodes.rationale: Pace of legal change requires at least annual refresh
